summary: Iteration 30: Tested rating comments/reviews, share for Suppliers/Activities/Referral partners (default #Allied Health share channel, set on startup), the 'services' field, admin editing of AGTS places, and the weekly Company Drive (resource) digest admin preview. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass. Frontend (375x667, public URL): review sheet with stars and comment saves, and the review shows in directory-reviews-{id}. When reopened, the comment is prefilled. The share header shows '#Allied Health' by default. Share to chat shows a 'Shared to #<channel>' toast, tested against a TEMP TEST channel. The referral form shows Company name, Services offered, Phone number, Website, Email and Location / postcode with no Contact person field. The saved card shows 'Services:' and '📍 location', and edit prefills services. place-edit opens a prefilled form; 'Save changes' updates the card and shows a toast. resource-digest-test-button shows the toast 'Preview sent to admin.test@example.com'. All features work. Only minor UX/design notes remain.

minor.issue: Shared message labels the location as 'Address:'. The referral form now calls this field 'Location / postcode'. Consider 'Location:' for referral partners.

issues: directory-review-comment TextInput reuses styles.search (backgroundColor c.surface), which is the same white as the sheet. The input has no visible border or fill, so it is hard to tell there is a field (see screenshot: only the placeholder shows).
The review Modal has no KeyboardAvoidingView or keyboard-aware wrapper. On native, the keyboard will cover the bottom-sheet comment field and the Save button.
The sheet title still says 'Share referrals to'. Shares now include Suppliers and Activities, so use something like 'Share to channel'.
The search filter matches name, contact, address and note but not the new 'services' field.
Action chips (Share/Phone/Email/Website) have minHeight 40, below the 44pt touch target.
The 'Save changes' button label wraps to two lines at 375px width.
The header title stays 'AGTS favourites' while editing, with no 'Edit favourite' title.

action_items: Give directory-review-comment a visible fill or border, e.g. backgroundColor surfaceSecondary or a border, inside the white sheet.
Wrap the review sheet content in KeyboardAvoidingView (or the keyboard-controller equivalent) so the keyboard does not hide the comment field and Save button.
Rename the channel-picker title 'Share referrals to' to a general label.
Optional: include 'services' in the directory search filter, and raise action chip minHeight to 44.
Optional: use the 'Location:' label in referral share messages, and stop the 'Save changes' label wrapping on the places form.
critical_code_review_comments: directory.shape() correctly pops raw ratings/comments. Reviews are sorted newest first and the stars come from the current rating.

When editing a referral entry, a legacy 'contact' value stays hidden in the form but is still re-sent. It shows on the card ('Contact:') and in shares, even though the form no longer exposes it. This is acceptable but may confuse admins.
resource_digest_loop stores its weekly meta key before sending. A failed send is never retried that week, which matches the existing digest_loop pattern.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ entries, places, channels conv_TEST_share30/conv_TEST_ui30 and their messages were all deleted. referral_share_channel was restored to conv_ab9e05c17d16 (Allied Health). The startup default was also verified by deleting the key and restarting the backend: it was recreated as Allied Health. No messages were posted to #Allied Health (its message count is still 2).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0. The frontend .env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. For share tests, use the seed_iter30_ui.py modes: seed / share_test (switches the share channel to a TEST channel) / cleanup (restores Allied Health). Review sheet modal: wait about 1s after opening for the slide animation before clicking inside. The resource digest test endpoint emails admin.test@example.com through the email integration (202 Accepted). One run had a transient 'Failed to load font Ionicons' network toast.
